title: lupinus lepidus var. utahensis
intro: Lupinus lepidus var. utahensis, commonly known as Utah lupine, is a perennial plant belonging to the legume family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including the potential health benefits of lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions attributed to Utah lupine include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Lupinus lepidus var. utahensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
